A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, A Tale of Two Imperatives: Privacy and Explainability. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–C support reliable comparison despite rearrangement and figure revisions.

before.justification: v1 reports original chest-X-ray and CIFAR-10 experiments, explanation and representation comparisons, LDP explanation results, and autoencoder anomaly-detection results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical studies and additionally reports absolute non-private CIFAR-10 accuracies in Table 2.

M1.justification: The DP-SGD/GroupNorm setup, selected explainers, grid-based Laplace perturbation of explanations, and hybrid software pipeline are retained. Changes to representation-analysis settings and implementation documentation do not establish a changed method or model.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same pneumonia/TB/normal chest-X-ray collection, CIFAR-10, and additional chest conditions for anomaly detection. Table 2 adds results for existing coverage, not a new dataset or task.

E2.justification: The evaluated explainer set remains Saliency, SmoothGrad, Integrated Gradients, Grad-Shap, and Grad-CAM, with the same exclusions from subsequent comparisons. The private/non-private model comparisons also retain their architectures.

E3.justification: Section 7 revises the stated aggregation from fifteen clusters for every network to seventeen for ResNet-34 and EfficientNet-V2 and fifteen for DenseNet-121; the heatmaps reflect this revision. This changes the reported analysis setting without establishing retraining or reruns. Main training budgets and dataset splits remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The representation-similarity analysis receives revised cluster summaries. Additionally, v1 reports similar dCKA results with linear and RBF kernels, whereas v3 retains that cross-kernel statement only for HSIC. The sensitivity investigations and LDP case studies otherwise remain.

E5.justification: The HSIC independence tests retain their gamma approximation and 0.05 significance threshold. Appendix C repeats this threshold while identifying the implementation; no new repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or uncertainty-reporting practice is introduced.

E6.justification: New Table 2 reports CIFAR-10 non-private accuracies of 72.82% for DenseNet-121 and 66.61% for ResNet-34. ResNet and EfficientNet heatmaps contain added or revised entries under revised layer grouping, which should not be read as same-setting gains. The principal explainer-performance plots and SSIM results are retained.

T1.justification: The PIS definition, Localization Assumption, DP/LDP definitions, Laplace sensitivity calculation, and Appendix C explainer formulas remain mathematically unchanged. The revised CKA discussion introduces no new formal derivation or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central contributions: explanation-quality desiderata, failure of the selected explainers under DP, a sensitivity-based interpretation, and the hybrid LDP framework. The added reporting does not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Section 7 expands discussion of CKA's confounding and bandwidth limitations and changes the characterization of representations from 'more or less dissimilar' to 'mildly similar.' The independent-sensitivity explanation and Section 11 applicability limitations remain.

D1.justification: Appendix C newly specifies Captum, Simtorch, PyRKHSstats, defaults, batching, Python 3.10, a V100 32GB GPU, and approximately 81 computational hours. Section 7 also supplies activation counts. These are disclosures, not established implementation changes. The specific code-release URL in v1 is removed, although a release promise remains.

R1.justification: The reference list and substantive research positioning are retained. Section 7 elaborates already-cited CKA and dCKA work without introducing a new citation or changing the claimed relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: Section 7 receives localized paragraph rewrites and subsection changes, Appendix B's discussion is reordered, and Appendix C gains implementation documentation. Most prose and the overall section sequence remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The retained heatmaps are compressed, restyled, and relocated, with Figures 4–6 consolidated on one page. Appendix B adds Table 2 and rearranges its figures, including moving the existing performance plot from Figure 10 to Figure 12. Other principal plots, the pipeline diagram, and LDP examples retain their displays.

improvement.justification: The added implementation information, explicit layer grouping, and absolute CIFAR-10 accuracies make existing results easier to assess and reproduce. These provide a modest net benefit despite more crowded heatmaps and removal of the specific code-release URL. The main claims, validation, and limitations remain essentially unchanged.
